run_search_perplexity: run a web search query using the Perplexity search provider via litellm.search
run_asearch_async: run an async web search query using litellm.asearch with a search provider
build_search_optional_params: build a dict of optional search parameters like max_results, domain filter, and country
run_multi_query_search: run a search with multiple queries passed as a list of strings
run_search_with_filters: run a search query with domain filter, max results, and country parameters
